items.title: Israeli stocks fall, shekel weakens as Netanyahu bloc beats election forecasts
items.desc: Israeli markets slump as Netanyahu’s bloc outperforms election forecasts but falls short of a majority, raising uncertainty over government formation and the prospect of another election.

items.title: Cyclone Arnab kills seven in Andhra Pradesh as heavy rain hits eastern India
items.desc: More than 180,000 people were evacuated in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha as the storm weakened after making landfall, disrupting flights and triggering heavy rain across several states.

items.title: Rain expected across Nepal on Thursday as cyclone weakens
items.desc: The system is forecast to bring rain from Thursday afternoon, with heavy downpours possible overnight and on Friday.

items.title: Israel’s vote prolongs Middle East instability
items.desc: The election leaves Netanyahu’s path to power uncertain but keeps the risk of further escalation with Iran alive, unsettling oil markets.

items.title: Nepal government’s film grant scheme gets mixed reviews
items.desc: The government aims to promote films that highlight the country’s culture, history and tourism. Filmmakers welcome the move but criticise the 21-day deadline.

items.title: Sudurpaschim Royals bounce back
items.desc: The Royals, which lost their first match against Lumbini Lions, handed Pokhara Avengers a six-wicket defeat on Wednesday.

items.title: Pakistan’s last-minute NOC demand hits NPL franchises hard
items.desc: A sudden $25,000 fee requirement from the Pakistan Cricket Board forces NPL teams to scramble for emergency replacements, dampening global appeal and leaving fans disappointed.

items.title: Driving licence applicants in Kathmandu face week-long waits for trials
items.desc: Server outages and excessive fees have added to applicants’ woes. Legal hurdles have delayed plans for new centres.

items.title: Ani Choying’s new role brings old controversies to the fore
items.desc: The government has appointed the Buddhist nun and singer to lead the Lumbini Development Trust despite unresolved questions over her citizenship and a money-laundering investigation dating back to 2018.

items.title: Constitutional bench in limbo as Supreme Court struggles over formation amid disagreements and boycotts
items.desc: When Chief Justice Sharma formed the bench on October 7, Justice Phuyal refused to sit, leading to the suspension of proceedings.

items.title: Nepal needs meaningful actions to end child marriage by 2030
items.desc: Nepal’s progress remains uneven, with poverty leaving girls in disadvantaged households more vulnerable.

items.title: Why investing in care is key to our shared future
items.desc: Care workers, most of them women, deserve recognition, decent work and social protection.

items.title: What a regional climate agreement for the Himalayas should contain
items.desc: Prime Minister Shah’s proposed Himalayan Climate Resilience Mechanism is a welcome start. A regional legal agreement among Nepal, India and China would give it a foundation.

items.title: Members push to revive SAARC, but India holds firm
items.desc: Twelve years since the last summit, the bloc remains paralysed by deep-seated rivalry between India and Pakistan, and the requirement for unanimous consent among its eight members.

items.title: Dashain exodus deepens blood shortage in Valley
items.desc: Daily demand exceeds 400 pints, but collections have fallen to around 20. Patients needing urgent surgery are among the hardest hit.
